answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 36247 Country: India Title: Is husband allowed to shave his wife's armpit and pubic hair Question: Is husband allowed to shave his wife's armpit and pubic hair? Also is she allowed to go ladies beauty parlor for her hair removal from her hand, legs and face by lady beautician? Please advice as soon as possible. Answer ID: 36247 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 195/L=109/TL=1433) (1) Husband is allowed to do so. (2) A woman is allowed to go to such beauty parlour for removing hair from her hands, legs or face where only women perform this duty. However, they are not allowed to go to a beauty parlour to sharpen the eyebrows or to do other unlawful things. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
